svg.title: Resilience4j default aspect order
svg.desc: Nested boxes show the default Resilience4j aspect order from outermost to innermost: Retry, CircuitBreaker, RateLimiter, TimeLimiter, Bulkhead, and finally the adapter method that calls the upstream. Retry is outermost, so every attempt passes through all inner layers again. The circuit breaker records each attempt's outcome, including timeouts. The rate limiter is not configured in this example. Retry is configured for pharmacy with 2 attempts. The time limiter applies its timeout to each attempt, for example 600 milliseconds for claims. The bulkhead caps concurrent calls, for example 50 for claims.
svg.text: A call enters at the outer ring and works inwards to the upstream call.

text.tspan: outermost: each attempt runs every inner layer again (pharmacy: 2 attempts)
records each attempt, so a timeout counts as a failure

svg.text: annotated adapter method → upstream HTTP call
Retry(CircuitBreaker(RateLimiter(TimeLimiter(Bulkhead(method))))). Example values from this page's YAML.
